page_title: JUV 2-0 MON | Juventus v Monza 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Maria Ferrieri Caputi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The Monza players can’t believe it after referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
90+5' Referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Monza. Let’s see what happens!
90+5' PENALTY APPEAL by Monza, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Fabio Miretti (Juventus) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) must have forgotten he already has a yellow card on his account today. He receives a second one and is dismissed.
90' Armando Izzo (Monza) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows for a foul.
89' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
88' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
86' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Monza earn a corner.
84' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
81' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Valentin Carboni will be replaced by Andrea Ferraris (Monza).
80' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' The substitution is prepared. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolo Fagioli.
78' The resulting corner from Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) comes to nothing.

76' A short pass finds Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
74' A substitution has been made. Pedro Pereira goes off and Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) comes on.
74' Here is a change. Alex Sandro is going off and Paolo Montero gives the last tactical orders to Tiago Djalo (Juventus).
73' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Arkadiusz Milik walks off.
71' Alessandro Sorrentino pulls off a great save to deny Daniele Rugani (Juventus), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
70' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
68' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pedro Pereira (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

66' Dany Mota (Monza) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
65' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.
65' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Samuele Birindelli and he is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Monza).
63' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) has received a yellow card for his foul.
61' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Alessandro Sorrentino.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus).
58' Armando Izzo (Monza) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' The game is interrupted now, Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

58' Armando Izzo (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Maria Ferrieri Caputi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
55' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

54' What a great touch by Federico Chiesa (Juventus)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

52' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
52' A lofted cross from Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
49' Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows his whistle for a foul after Alex Sandro (Juventus) hacks down one of his opponents.
48' Warren Bondo (Monza) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Carlo Pinsoglio easily deals with the threat.
46' The game is over for Mattia Perin. Carlo Pinsoglio (Juventus) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Raffaele Palladino decided to make a change. Roberto Gagliardini is replaced by Warren Bondo (Monza).
46' Half-time substitution. Andrea Colpani is replaced by Milan Djuric (Monza).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' The Monza players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Dany Mota (Monza) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentin Carboni (Monza) was quite harsh and Maria Ferrieri Caputi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' A pass by Pedro Pereira (Monza) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' Danilo (Juventus) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.

35' Andrea Colpani (Monza) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
33' The total number of attempts is 7:4.
28' 2 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Alex Sandro (Juventus) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:0.

28' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Juventus will take a corner kick.
26' 1 - 0 Federico Chiesa (Juventus) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
25' What a great touch by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
25' Timothy Weah (Juventus) passes the ball onto Arkadiusz Milik, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
23' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
21' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.

17' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
16' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows his whistle for an infringement.
15' Andrea Colpani (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Rough tackle by Daniele Rugani (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Juventus control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Andrea Colpani (Monza) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Mattia Perin to dive and make a save.
9' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Maria Ferrieri Caputi stops the game and makes a call.
8' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
5' Armando Izzo (Monza) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
3' Dany Mota (Monza) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maria Ferrieri Caputi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
